description.narrative:
Stakeholder Effects: Increased access to affordable housing finance, including for women borrowers: Through this Project IFC aims to increase access to affordable housing finance and encourage home ownership for lower-income segments. The Project also seeks to finance women borrowers to reduce the gender specific investment gap in affordable housing segment.
Market Creation: Competitiveness: IFCs support for the Project, coupled with IFCs other systematic interventions in affordable housing finance, is expected to promote greater competitiveness in the segment, by demonstrating the viability of providing such financing to lower income segments, especially to women borrowers.

The proposed investment comprises of an investment of US$ denominated, senior secured loan of up to US$50 million in Aadhar Housing Finance Limited (Aadhar or the Company), one of the largest low income finance companies in India (the Project). IFCs debt proceeds will be utilized by the Company to extend financing for purchase, construction, and extension of affordable homes to economically weaker sections (EWS), lower income groups (LIG) and middle-income groups (MIG) segments, including women borrowers. A portion of IFCs investment proceeds will also be utilized by the Company for financing the targeted borrower groups in the state of Uttar Pradesh in India.
